title: EXE-01 — execution broker + bubblewrap sandbox + runtime images + escape suite (ARCH-12-001..018 user-space core)
commit_message: feat(execution): EXE-01 broker+sandbox+escape suite + host GPU benchmarks (ARCH-12-001..018)

scope_split.delivered: user-space core: application port + typed states/refusals, adapters/execution (host_probe, spec_protocol Ed25519 signed+nonce-bound envelopes, content-addressed RuntimeImageStore w/ SBOM slot + full re-verification, DelegatedCgroupController, BubblewrapExecutionProvider, OutputCollector validate->quarantine->blob->publish-after-authz, 0600 Unix-socket ExecutionBroker + BrokerExecutionClient), 22 unit tests, 7-test live escape suite (SANDBOX-SEC-001) running REAL bwrap 0.11.0 + busybox 1.37 + delegated cgroup v2

commands.result: Success: no issues in 208 source files (baseline 199 + 9 new execution modules; prior review: 8 errors -> 0)
7 passed in ~0.5s on THIS host (real bwrap; 3 consecutive runs stable)

commands.cmd: rtk uv run pytest tests/meta tests/architecture tests/unit -q

commands.result: A1 unsigned->unsigned_spec; A2 tampered argv->bad_signature; B1 boundaries hold+declared output collected; B2 symlink traversal blocked + planted undeclared artifact rejected (policy_violation); C memory OOM enforced (oom_kill=1, exit 137); D seccomp fact corrected (Seccomp:2 installable)

takeover_fixes: import typos + PyNaCl API names: verified fixed (grep empty; crypto_sign/keypair/open correct)
envelope nonce = typed spec nonce: verified (client signs spec.nonce or mints; broker binds verified.nonce into parsed spec)
strict wire-response parsing: outcome_from_wire rewritten strict (typed PROTOCOL_TRANSPORT refusal on any drift; base64 validate=True; no coercion)
cgroup-mandatory posture: provider now constructs the real DelegatedCgroupController whenever posture verifies a delegated root (no silent killpg degradation under a cgroups-mandatory posture)
unmanifested-file rejection: images.verify compares full inventory vs manifest (verified by unit test)
undeclared-artifact rejection: OutputCollector._validate_output_tree refuses every undeclared entry (verified by unit test + escape suite)

NEW boundary defects found and fixed during QA: (1) bwrap --size applied to the wrong --tmpfs (quota now precedes --tmpfs /tmp); (2) memory.max alone was a soft ceiling — memory.swap.max=0 now written per-execution; (3) post-Popen cgroup attach raced the payload fork — replaced by preexec_fn self-join so the sandboxed tree inherits limits from its first instruction
deferred: admin deployment form (T8-class): dedicated unprivileged service account + systemd unit + cgroup delegation drop-in + admin-run RuntimeImageStore.install flow (installer CLI wrapping it) — prototype runs the identical user-space core under the current account
D11 GPU benchmark bundle: BLOCKED on user (GPU usage window) + D16 (download authorization) — no downloads performed; host GPU benchmark evidence intentionally absent from this commit

bwrap 0.11.0-vs-0.12.0 GHSA-pxhw-h44j-8pfx delta (sandbox-setup symlink traversal fix + setuid-mode removal, both in 0.12.0): mitigated in 0.11.0 by broker-ONLY argv construction from broker-generated symlink-free mount sources (no client-controlled path ever reaches bwrap; images reject symlinks at install AND verify); admin upgrade to 0.12.0 pending

seccomp: host fact CORRECTED during QA — the kernel CAN install bwrap seccomp filters (probe verified Seccomp:2/1 filter; the earlier EINVAL record did not hold under the real NoNewPrivs launch path); executions still omit seccomp because no reviewed filter is curated for the runtime image (SHOULD-level deferral: curate per-image filters); isolation never weakened

escape-suite CI wiring: tests/security/sandbox runs host-gated via pytest (executed green on this host); adding it to ci/run.sh's step list is deferred until the deployment form defines which hosts must run it

host_facts.seccomp: installable under bwrap (Seccomp:2 verified live); not applied (no curated filter)
host_facts.cgroup_v2: systemd user@1000.service delegation; nearest writable root discovered at app.slice/...; cpu+memory+pids controllers; cgroup.kill verified
